messages.subject: Bug when cancelling subscription
parts:
Steps to reproduce:
  1. Purchase a monthly starter / basic plan
  2. Cancel it immediately
Expected result: subscription lasts for 30 days and gets cancelled

Actual result: subscription is cancelled immediately and all credits are lost (credit card is still charged the full amount).

This is surprising because most online services (Amazon prime, Netflix, Spotify, etc) gives you membership until the end of the subscription period, not immediately after you cancel. Please restore the credits I purchased (starter plan, 100 hours). My username is luckyt and app id is 313623.

Thanks
